# Swaroop Studios

> Cinematic wedding photography and filmmaking studio. Photography studio
> established in 1972, based in Bengaluru, India.

## Who we are

- Name: Swaroop Studios
- Established: 1972
- Location: Bengaluru, India
- Site: https://www.swaroopstudios.com/
- Contact: +91 99004 86574 · swaroopstudios@gmail.com · WhatsApp +91 90360 55099
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swaroop_studios

Swaroop Studios documents weddings, events, corporate assignments and
portraits, with an observational approach: present for what happens, rather
than staging it. The site also presents silent cinematic wedding and studio
films.

## Services

- Weddings: pre-wedding, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, ceremony, reception and
  candid coverage.
- Events: birthdays, anniversaries, engagements, cultural and religious events.
- Corporate: conferences, launches, award ceremonies, brand and team events.
- Portraits & headshots: executive headshots, personal branding, studio
  portraiture.
- Complete coverage: end-to-end documentation from preparation through
  completion.
- Private & VIP engagements: NDA on request, security-aware scheduling, small
  vetted team, password-protected private delivery. Images are never shared
  or published without written approval.

No fixed pricing is published on the site; every assignment is quoted
individually via the contact page.

The gallery organises photographs into Weddings, Events, Corporate and
Portraits. Private client galleries are password-protected and are NOT public.
